messages.content: RoboRide launches autonomous ride-share service in Millfield. Price: $0.18 per mile. Average wait time: 15 minutes. Coverage: main roads and commercial areas.

You Apply for Maria Santos's $5,000 small business stabilization grant. Fill out the paperwork this week. The qualification criteria are met. The money is not for spending — it is for extending runway if the 60% drop scenario materializes. A $5,000 cushion converts a 6.4-month runway into something closer to 7.5 months at 60% revenue loss. That is the difference between having time to adapt and not having time.. Savings grew by $116.
